serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You hand him over the 6 million dollars…
You: S-Sorry, here’s the money.
#Landlord.Arms.Money
#Landlord.Face.Grin
Landlord: O-Oh, wow. I never held so much money before. Mine is always well hidden in a dozen separate locations. 
Landlord: Don’t worry, your money is safe with me. Huehehehehe~
You: Your laugh is not filling me with confidence.
Landlord: Stop being a wuss. Get ready. Soon we are leaving this place! 
You: How soon?
Landlord: Oh, I still have some things to do. Most of my money is frozen in assets. I don’t need to sell them all immediately, so it shouldn’t take long.
You: Sure, no problem. 
Landlord: See you later, then, partner. Huehehehehe~
